scenario: Kill two checkout-api instances under load
notes: Autoscaling replaced both in 3 minutes; no errors seen by users.

scenario: Fail over orders-db to the replica
notes: Failover took 4 minutes; 31 checkouts failed during the switch.

scenario: Restore orders-db from last night's backup
notes: Backup bucket unencrypted and unlabelled; restore steps were not written down; took 2.5 hours.

scenario: Roll back a bad checkout-api deploy
notes: One-click rollback in the pipeline worked.

scenario: Payment gateway returns errors for 10 minutes
success_criterion: Customers see a retry message, orders queued
notes: No fallback: checkout showed a blank error page until the gateway recovered.

scenario: Burn-rate alert fires and reaches on-call
notes: Alert went to an email list; on-call saw it 9 minutes later.

scenario: Traffic at 1.6x last year's peak in staging
notes: Passed with the pooler and the larger database: p95 610 ms, errors 0.2%.
